articles.title: Portentous Song
articles.author: Alex Tan
articles.excerpt: The farmer’s shovel is bloody as he lifts it from the field of young wheat. The women’s needles are bloody, and the rare bread on the table is bloody. The men’s hands are bloody, because in this land nobody’s enemy gets away.
